# MyTuums

> The social media, for gamers.

MyTuums is a gaming-first social network: posts and threads, reposts and
quotes, likes and bookmarks, follows, and human-reviewed moderation with
in-app appeals.

- App: [https://mytuums.com](https://mytuums.com)
- Create an account: [https://mytuums.com/register](https://mytuums.com/register)
- Sign in: [https://mytuums.com/login](https://mytuums.com/login)
- X (Twitter): [https://x.com/mytuums](https://x.com/mytuums)
- Instagram: [https://www.instagram.com/mytuums/](https://www.instagram.com/mytuums/)
- TikTok: [https://www.tiktok.com/@mytuums](https://www.tiktok.com/@mytuums)
- YouTube: [https://www.youtube.com/@MyTuums](https://www.youtube.com/@MyTuums)
- GitHub: [https://github.com/MyTuums](https://github.com/MyTuums)

## Notes

- This landing site ([https://about.mytuums.com](https://about.mytuums.com))
  is available in English and French; the language is chosen in the page
  header.
- The product requires an account for posting and browsing feeds, but
  individual post permalinks are publicly readable — see the app's own
  [llms.txt](https://mytuums.com/llms.txt) for the public surface.
